title: Population and statistics (ASTAT)
description: Official statistics by municipality from ASTAT, the provincial statistics institute: resident population, families, language groups, tourism, vehicles, census sections. Community MIRROR of the Province's open geodata (CC0 1.0), extracted 2026-09-03 from the provincial WFS; not an official publication. Attribution to the Province is given in every collection.
